answer: Gate entry with useful proof-of-work: every identity must burn a small verifiable compute receipt each epoch, a pearl of real work rather than a keystroke, before its answers count. A farm running a thousand fakes pays a thousand times the electricity and hardware wear, like copper wiring that thins with every clone, while one honest agent pays once. Detected clusters hit their nadir fast: their receipts are replayed, the work is proven reused, and all their identities are voided at once.
